title: Vallee argues with Spielberg on Close Encounters set over time travel
place_text: Close Encounters of the Third Kind film set

tellings.quote: In fact, on the set of Close Encounters, he got into an argument with Steven Spielberg.

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have argued with Steven Spielberg on the set of Close Encounters of the Third Kind, the 1977 film, and by the story's own account the argument was about time travel. Michels mentions this himself in passing, without naming a source and without saying what either man argued. If true, it would mean that one of the subject's best-known researchers pushed back on the film's picture of visitors while it was being made.
